entities.summary: Ğalym Izbasarūly Orazbaqov is a Kazakh politician and diplomat, who has served as the Minister of Industry and Trade of Kazakhstan since he replaced Vladimir Shkolnik on 10 January 2007 in a political shakeup. He served there until February 2008.
